title: Physical security in practice
intro: Sometimes an attack walks in the door. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Unexpected technician at reception

artifact.name: Reception desk
body: Hello, there is an air conditioning technician here. He says you, excuse me, called him. Shall I send him up?

options.label: I did not call anyone, keep him at the desk

decisions.explain: An unexpected visitor does not get in without a check.

decisions.title: Message from Elnur Hüseynov
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: Elnur Hüseynov
body: Hi, I left my badge at home. Leave yours at the guard post, I will return it tonight.

options.label: No, get a temporary badge at the post

decisions.explain: The guard post checks ID and issues a temporary badge.

decisions.title: Drive found in the corridor
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this file?
decisions.explain: Never plug in a found device, give it to the specialists.

decisions.title: Visitor names a manager

artifact.name: Reception desk
body: He says Mr Kamran approved it. He only needs five minutes in the server room.

options.label: I check the order with facilities

decisions.explain: Check the order through official channels, not the visitor's word.

decisions.title: Kontakto: Gulnar tagged you in a photo
decisions.prompt: Your badge is clearly visible in the photo. What do you do?

artifact.title: Kontakto: Gulnar tagged you in a photo

options.label: Ask Gulnar to change the photo

decisions.explain: A photo of the badge can help someone fake it or get into the building.
